name: Dimitri From Paris
description: The legendary French disco and house producer is in town for one night only. Get ready for a sophisticated and groovy set.
longDescription:
Dimitri From Paris, the acclaimed French DJ and producer, brings his signature blend of disco, funk, and house music to Porto. Known for his extensive discography of remixes and original productions, Dimitri has been a prominent figure in the global electronic music scene since the 1990s, celebrated for his sophisticated selections and ability to craft sets that are both danceable and musically rich. His work often pays homage to the golden era of disco while incorporating modern house sensibilities.

Attendees at Switch can anticipate an evening of sophisticated grooves and infectious rhythms. The atmosphere is expected to be energetic yet refined, drawing a crowd appreciative of classic and contemporary dance music. Switch, a well-regarded venue in Porto's nightlife landscape, provides an intimate setting for this kind of performance, allowing for a direct connection between the artist and the audience.

Tickets are available for purchase. Switch is located within walking distance of the Aliados metro station, making it easily accessible from various parts of Porto.
